title: Replace track_dao.dart's stringly-typed TrackState class with a real Dart enum
why: TrackState is a 4-value closed lifecycle (active/retired/archived/deleted) central to this HOTSPOT file's whole model, modeled as bare String constants on a TextColumn with no DB-level or compiler-level check that only these 4 values ever get stored. Any code that branches on `.state` gets no exhaustiveness checking, and nothing stops a typo'd string reaching the column (mitigated today only by everyone remembering to use the TrackState.* constants rather than literals — a convention, not a guarantee).
recommendation: Model TrackState as a real Dart `enum` (or use Drift's `.withConverter` to store it as text but expose an enum in Dart), so switches over track state are compiler-exhaustive and no non-member string can be constructed.
acceptance_criteria: TrackState is a Dart enum (or enum-backed column); all TrackState.active-style call sites in this batch keep compiling.
Any switch/when over the state value is exhaustive without a default/_ arm.
